configuration.title: ok-script Lang Hints
config.langDirectory: Language JSON directory relative to the workspace root.
config.poDirectory: gettext PO directory relative to the workspace root, using <locale>/LC_MESSAGES/*.po.
config.enablePoData: Enable gettext PO data for OCR match hints.
config.poDomains: gettext PO domains to load. The default only loads ocr.
config.displayLocale: Default locale for inline hints. auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.enableInlayHints: Enable inline hints for language values and effects.
config.featureAliases: Aliases used for FeatureList template completion and hover.
config.effectsFile: EffectType and EFFECT_DESCRIPTIONS Python file relative to the workspace root.
config.okScriptProjectPath: ok-script project root containing src/config.py. Used by the task launcher.
config.okScriptPython: Python interpreter used to run ok-script tasks. Empty uses the target project's .venv on Windows.
config.characterProjectPath: Project root used by the character and skill manager. Empty falls back to okScriptProjectPath and the current workspace.
config.characterMasterFile: Character master JSON relative to the character project root.
config.characterSkillsDirectory: Character skill JSON directory relative to the character project root.
config.characterLocaleFile: Character name localization JSON relative to the character project root.
config.characterAvatarTemplateRegex: Regular expression for avatar template names. The first capture group is used when present; otherwise the text after the matched prefix is compared with the character's English slug. Defaults to battleicon/battle_icon/battle-icon prefixes.
config.okTemplatesDirectory: ok_templates folder name relative to the workspace root. Used by the template asset manager.
config.annotationKeybindings: Keyboard shortcuts for the annotation editor. Each value is a key name, optionally prefixed with modifier(s) joined by `+` (e.g. `ctrl+z`, `shift+d`). Supported keys: letters, digits, `Delete`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, etc.
